$comment: FIT-12 deprecation register. Every entry names a legacy write path (table / command / net event), its owner, the replacement and how many occurrences are tolerated until `expires`. The scanner (tests/architecture/test_deprecations.py) fails when a path grows past `expected_writes` (new debt), when an expired entry still exists, or when an entry matches nothing (stale). Entries may only shrink; retiring a path means deleting its entry in the same change.
